The behaviors skill now mandates a `README.md` in every corpus folder in place of `overview.md`.

Each `README.md` must open with a fixed incipit -- "Understanding this behavior corpus calls for the tmr-behaviors skill; consult it when reading this file." -- so any reader reaching a corpus file is pointed at the tmr-behaviors skill.

`README` is reserved (no `.feature` file may be named `README`), and `README.md` is exempt from the kebab-case and sidecar-matching rules that govern every other file.
